knowledge.topic: What is OPC / About OPC Punjab
knowledge.content:
The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission (POPC) is a special institution established by the Government of Punjab under the Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act 2021.

Main purpose:
- Protect rights and interests of Overseas Pakistanis from Punjab
- Provide a one-stop solution for complaints and issues in Pakistan
- Act as bridge between Overseas Pakistanis and government departments
- Ensure issues are addressed promptly and effectively

POPC is a provincial body specifically serving Overseas Pakistanis from Punjab.
Head Office: 1 Club Road, GOR-I, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan

knowledge.topic: Who is eligible / Who qualifies as Overseas Pakistani
knowledge.content:
You are eligible to use POPC services if you are:
- A Pakistani citizen living abroad for employment or business
- Holder of CNIC, NICOP (National Identity Card for Overseas Pakistanis) or POC (Pakistan Origin Card)
- A dual national with origins in Punjab province
- A foreign national of Pakistani origin holding NICOP or POC with issues in Punjab

Note: POPC specifically serves people with roots in Punjab. For other provinces, contact relevant provincial authorities.

knowledge.topic: How to file a complaint / How to register a complaint
knowledge.content:
You can file a complaint through 3 channels:

1. 🌐 Online Portal (RECOMMENDED): Visit https://ospc.punjab.gov.pk — file from anywhere in the world, 24/7. You get a unique complaint number to track progress.

2. 🏢 Walk-in: Visit POPC office at 1 Club Road, GOR-I, Lahore. You or your authorized representative can come in person.

3. 📧 Email: Send documents to info@opc.punjab.gov.pk

You do NOT need to be in Pakistan to file. Someone else can file on your behalf with an authority letter or Power of Attorney.

knowledge.topic: Documents required / What documents do I need
knowledge.content:
To file a complaint with POPC you need:

✅ Copy of CNIC / NICOP / POC
✅ Copy of valid Visa OR Foreign Passport OR Residence Card OR Iqama
✅ Your full name and contact details including foreign address
✅ Clear description of your complaint
✅ Details of the person or department you are complaining against
✅ Copies of all relevant supporting documents
✅ Authority letter (if someone is representing you in Pakistan)

You can file in English or Urdu. No rigid format required — just be clear and include all details.

knowledge.topic: What types of complaints are handled / What issues does OPC solve
knowledge.content:
POPC handles a wide range of complaints:

🏠 Property: Land grabbing, illegal possession, housing society disputes
👨‍👩‍👧 Family: Disputes requiring legal or administrative help
⚖️ Criminal: FIR registration, police investigation issues
🏛️ Government Departments: Any Punjab government department
💡 Utilities: Electricity (WAPDA/LESCO), Gas (SNGPL), Water (WASA)
🏦 Banking: Frozen accounts, bank disputes, Roshan Digital Account issues
💼 Employment: Recruitment fraud, business disputes
📋 Documents: NOC delays, lost documents, license issues

POPC does NOT handle:
- Anonymous or false complaints
- Issues outside Punjab province
- Cases already in court (sub-judice)
- Cases where complainant has no personal interest

knowledge.topic: How does the complaint process work / Complaint redressal process
knowledge.content:
The OPC complaint process works in these steps:

1. SUBMIT — File via portal, email or in person
2. REGISTER — You get a unique complaint number
3. SCRUTINIZE — Complaint is checked for jurisdiction
4. REFER — Forwarded to relevant government department or District Committee (DOPC)
5. HEARING — Both parties heard. Video calls available for overseas complainants
6. FOLLOW-UP — POPC monitors progress and sends reminders
7. RESOLVE — Case marked resolved when complainant confirms satisfaction

Track your complaint at: https://ospc.punjab.gov.pk

knowledge.topic: Is the service free / Are there any fees / Cost
knowledge.content:
Yes! All services provided by the Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission (POPC) are completely FREE OF CHARGE.

There are absolutely no registration fees, processing fees, or hidden charges for filing or following up on any complaint.

knowledge.topic: How to track complaint / Track my case / Check complaint status
knowledge.content:
To track your POPC complaint:

1. Visit: https://ospc.punjab.gov.pk
2. Log in to your account
3. Use your unique complaint number assigned when you filed
4. View current status and updates from your dealing officer

You can also:
- Submit additional documents through the portal
- Call helpline: 111-672-672
- Email: info@opc.punjab.gov.pk

knowledge.topic: Can I file from abroad / File complaint from outside Pakistan
knowledge.content:
Yes! You can file and follow up on your complaint from anywhere in the world.

Options from abroad:
1. 🌐 Online Portal: https://ospc.punjab.gov.pk — available 24/7
2. 📧 Email: info@opc.punjab.gov.pk
3. 📹 Video Hearings: POPC offers Skype, WhatsApp, and Zoom hearings so you do not need to travel to Pakistan
4. 👤 Representative: A close relative or person with Power of Attorney can file and attend hearings on your behalf in Pakistan

You do NOT need to physically come to Pakistan.

knowledge.topic: Property disputes / Land grabbing / Housing society issues
knowledge.content:
POPC is highly effective for property disputes:

✅ What POPC can help with:
- Illegal possession and land grabbing
- Housing society disputes
- Getting FIR registered if police refuse
- Verifying documents with PLRA (Punjab Land Records Authority)
- Retrieving lost property documents
- Agricultural land disputes

🛡️ Prevention tips:
- Ensure property is in the PLRA digital system
- Have a trusted person check regularly
- Use specific time-bound Special Power of Attorney — never a vague General POA
- Keep property tax and utility bills updated

⚠️ For immediate stay orders go directly to Civil Court as POPC cannot issue injunctions.

knowledge.topic: Power of Attorney advice / POA guidance
knowledge.content:
POPC's key advice on Power of Attorney:

✅ Best Practices:
- Be SPECIFIC: State exact powers (e.g. sell property X — not manage all affairs)
- Add a TIME LIMIT: Specify validity period (e.g. 6 months)
- Require JOINT SIGNATORIES: Two people who must act together
- Get it attested by Pakistan Embassy or Consulate in your country
- Register it in Pakistan if it involves property

⚠️ NEVER give a vague General Power of Attorney. Always use a specific time-bound Special Power of Attorney.

knowledge.topic: Video conferencing hearings / Online hearings / Attend hearing from abroad
knowledge.content:
POPC provides video conferencing so you can attend hearings from abroad without travelling to Pakistan.

How it works:
1. You are given a scheduled hearing date and time
2. POPC uses: Skype, WhatsApp, or Zoom
3. You join from your country of residence
4. Both parties are heard fairly

This saves significant travel cost and time for overseas complainants.

knowledge.topic: Utility complaints / Electricity gas water issues / WAPDA SNGPL WASA
knowledge.content:
POPC can assist with utility issues:

⚡ Electricity (WAPDA/LESCO): Delayed connections, wrongful disconnection, over-billing — POPC contacts the CEO of the concerned company

🔥 Gas (SNGPL): New gas connection delays — POPC follows up with Sui Northern Gas

💧 Water (WASA): Supply issues, sewerage problems, incorrect billing — POPC contacts the MD of WASA

🏦 Banking: Frozen accounts without valid reason — POPC asks bank for legal justification
Roshan Digital Account (RDA) problems — POPC forwards to State Bank of Pakistan

knowledge.topic: Criminal matters / FIR registration / Police complaints
knowledge.content:
POPC can assist with criminal matters:

✅ If police refuse to register your FIR: POPC can intervene and direct police to proceed as per law
✅ Police investigation complaints: POPC can ask senior officers to review a faulty investigation
✅ Inter-provincial matters: POPC can direct Punjab Police to register FIR even if accused is in another province
✅ Court decree implementation: POPC can help ensure court decisions are implemented

❌ POPC CANNOT take cognizance of matters already in court (sub-judice).

knowledge.topic: POPC legal powers / What can OPC do / OPC authority
knowledge.content:
POPC Legal Authority:
✅ Directions to provincial government departments are BINDING under the POPC Act
✅ Can summon officials and seek reports
✅ Can recommend disciplinary action against non-compliant officials
✅ Can recommend anti-corruption proceedings

Limitations:
❌ Cannot act as a formal court (cannot pass decrees or sentence anyone)
❌ Cannot handle sub-judice matters (already in court)
❌ Primary jurisdiction is Punjab only
❌ Cannot award financial damages (you need civil court for this)

You CAN still go to court alongside or after POPC proceedings.

knowledge.topic: Inheritance / Family matters / Legal heirs / NADRA family tree
knowledge.content:
POPC assistance with inheritance and family matters:

✅ If the original overseas Pakistani has passed away:
- Legal heirs with succession certificate can file or continue the complaint

✅ NADRA family tree errors affecting inheritance:
- POPC can take up errors in Family Registration Certificates (FRC)
- Coordinates with NADRA regional headquarters for correction

✅ Lost inheritance documents:
- POPC can direct Sub-Registrar Office or Revenue Department to issue certified copies

knowledge.topic: Investment / Business facilitation / Starting business in Pakistan
knowledge.content:
POPC supports Overseas Pakistani investors:

✅ Investment guidance: Directed to Punjab Board of Investment and Trade (PBIT)
✅ Special Economic Zones and tax holiday information
✅ Business debt recovery: POPC acts as mediator
✅ Commercial contract disputes with government departments
✅ Company registration delays (SECP liaison)
✅ NOC delays: POPC can ask department head to expedite

💡 Always use formal legal channels for all transactions and keep meticulous records.

knowledge.topic: Priority cases / Fast track complaints / Urgent cases
knowledge.content:
POPC gives special priority to:

🔴 Fast-tracked cases:
- Senior citizens (elderly Overseas Pakistanis)
- Widows
- Cases involving illegal dispossession
- Threats to life
- Urgent situations requiring immediate action

Multiple-department complaints are handled most effectively by POPC as it coordinates all departments simultaneously through a single window.

knowledge.topic: Commission members / Who runs OPC / Commission constitution
knowledge.content:
The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission is constituted as follows:

1. Chief Minister Punjab — Chairperson
2. Barrister Amjad Malik — Vice Chairperson
3. 9 x MPAs — Vacant
4. 9 x Private Members — Vacant
5. Commissioner OPC — Member/Secretary
6. Chief Secretary Punjab — Official Member
7. Senior Member Board of Revenue Punjab — Official Member
8. Chairman Planning & Development Board Punjab — Official Member
9. Additional Chief Secretary (Home) Punjab — Official Member
10. Provincial Police Officer Punjab — Official Member
11. Chairman Punjab Board of Investment & Trade — Official Member
12. Chairman Punjab Information Technology Board — Official Member
13. Advocate General Punjab — Official Member
14. Prosecutor General Punjab — Official Member

knowledge.topic: Governing law / Legal framework / OPC Act
knowledge.content:
The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission operates under:

📋 The Punjab Overseas Pakistanis Commission Act 2021

This Act of the Punjab Assembly establishes the legal mandate, powers, functions and institutional framework of POPC. It defines:
- Composition of the Commission
- Role of the Commissioner
- District Committees structure
- Advisory Councils framework

The Act can be downloaded from the official POPC website: https://ospc.punjab.gov.pk
